integrity: The universal proof is analytical, with finite exact-arithmetic checks only as corroboration; no external mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns canonical degree-one Johnson projections with normalized counting measure; no finite-n exact optimal rank or convergence rate is claimed. The hypergeometric mean-absolute-deviation collapse is known prior work. A closely related 2026 manuscript was accessible at abstract level only and unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: Sharp sparse-rank amplification for first Johnson spectral projections
